title: PW Patches
description: This mod adds various patches for the PW Minecraft server.
body: This mod adds an item called the Reusable Enriching Campfire. It is crafted by simply putting a normal Enriching Campfire into the crafting grid and you cannot obtain the Enriching Campfire back from it. Combining Yellowcake and the Reusable Enriching Campfire will create Enriched Yellowcake and keep the Reusable Enriching Campfire in the crafting grid. This mod is made to avoid the normal enriching process, which crashes the game for me and some of my friends.
